what: paired AUC-difference bootstrap for every adjudicated contrast, at four exchangeability units alongside the published video unit

cluster_schemes.source: the swapped-in face identity; a real video is its own identity (FF++ test: 140 clusters of 5 — one real and the four manipulations that take their face from it)
cluster_schemes.target: the footage identity: a real video and the manipulations built on that same footage (FF++ test: 140 clusters of 5)
cluster_schemes.basevideo: one cluster per manipulated base video (its manipulation methods) and one per real video (FF++ test: 280 clusters)
cluster_schemes.pair: the unordered identity pair of the official split — the coarsest unit, which absorbs the target and the source dependence at once (FF++ test: 70 clusters of 10)
